name: checkbox
description: A native checkbox input styled to match the design system, with controlled and uncontrolled support
designIntent: The Checkbox component is the standard way to let users select zero or more options from a set. It wraps the native input so keyboard, form, and screen-reader behavior is identical to platform checkboxes.

props.name: checked
props.description: Controlled checked state; omit for uncontrolled usage

props.name: onCheckedChange
props.description: Fired when the user toggles the checkbox

examples.title: Basic checkbox
examples.description: Simple checkbox with an accessible label

examples.title: With visible label
examples.description: Checkbox paired with a visible Label

antiPatterns.title: Don't use Checkbox for mutually exclusive choices
antiPatterns.explanation: Checkbox is for multi-select. Use Radio (inside RadioGroup) when only one option can be chosen.
antiPatterns.example:
// Avoid: Checkboxes for exclusive choice
<Checkbox /> Free
<Checkbox /> Pro

// Prefer: RadioGroup
<RadioGroup name="plan" legend="Plan">
  <RadioGroupItem value="free" label="Free" />
  <RadioGroupItem value="pro" label="Pro" />
</RadioGroup>

antiPatterns.title: Don't use Checkbox as a toggle for settings
antiPatterns.explanation: For binary settings that apply immediately, use Switch which announces on/off state.

accessibility.implementation: Wraps input[type=checkbox]; keyboard and screen-reader behavior is the platform default
accessibility.userRequirements: Provide an accessible name via aria-label or an associated Label
Don't remove the focus ring with CSS overrides

guidelines: Phrase as the thing being agreed to, not an action

compositionRules.relationship: Always pair with a Label or aria-label for accessibility
